name: Evelyn Regner - Après le considérant 7 - Am 87
title: REPORT on the proposal for a Council directive on Business in Europe: Framework for Income Taxation (BEFIT)
part_text: (7 b) In order to avoid the delocalisation of profits outside the Union by MNEs, BEFIT groups should also declare their global profit at the international level. The formula used in this Directive would then also be used to compare the profits originally declared in the Union with the ones that would have been declared if the formula was applied to the global profits of the BEFIT group. If the corrected profits are higher than the declared profits, the Union will tax those corrected profits thanks to the formula included in this Directive.
